places.title: Angkor Wat
places.excerpt: The world's largest religious monument, famous for its sunrise views and centuries-old stone carvings.

places.title: Koh Rong Island
places.excerpt: White-sand beaches, clear turquoise water, and glowing plankton after dark make this island a coastal favorite.

places.title: Bokor National Park
places.excerpt: A misty mountain retreat with an abandoned French hill station, waterfalls, and sweeping coastal views.

places.title: Kep & the Crab Market
places.excerpt: A quiet seaside town known for fresh Kampot-pepper crab, colonial-era ruins, and relaxed beach walks.

places.title: Tonle Sap Lake
places.excerpt: Southeast Asia's largest freshwater lake, home to floating villages and a rhythm of life tied to the tides.
